title: Narrowest Stable Public OMP Boundary for Provider Quota Telemetry
question: What is the narrowest stable/public OMP boundary through which KAD should consume native provider usage without importing fork-private internals?

evaluated_options.name: Public OMP Usage CLI / Structured JSON (`omp usage --json`)
evaluated_options.pros: Documented, stable JSON schema (`reports[]`, `limits[]`, `windows`, `metadata`). Isolates KAD from internal JS module paths. Supports offline caching, manual refresh, and CLI inspection.
evaluated_options.cons: Subprocess execution cost (~50-100ms cached, ~1.5s live remote query).
evaluated_options.verdict: SELECTED for Authoritative Baseline & Periodic Snapshot

evaluated_options.name: Public Extension Context API
evaluated_options.cons: Only exposes session-scoped context window stats (`ctx.getContextUsage()`), not multi-account provider quota reports.
evaluated_options.verdict: RETAINED for live session token counting

evaluated_options.name: Passive `after_provider_response` Extension Hook
evaluated_options.pros: Zero network overhead, event-driven in-process notification with status, headers, requestId, and ctx.model.
evaluated_options.cons: Only observes active turn responses; cannot observe baseline quota before first turn without snapshot.

evaluated_options.name: Direct OMP Internal Package / SQLite DB Access
evaluated_options.cons: Violates isolation; couples KAD to private schema; risks exposing secret authentication rows.

chosen_architecture.principle: One Authority Chain: OMP interprets provider-specific quota; KAD normalizes into kad-telemetry-v1.
chosen_architecture.baseline_adapter: omp-usage-adapter.mjs consumes `omp usage --json` structured report into AUTHORITATIVE_REMOTE telemetry records.
chosen_architecture.passive_hook: Extension registers `after_provider_response` to track OBSERVED response status/freshness without active polling.
chosen_architecture.multi_window_preservation: Multiple windows (e.g. Codex 5h primary, 7d secondary, Google Antigravity project quotas) are retained independently as distinct scoped records.
chosen_architecture.epistemic_rule: Explicit provider status (allowed=true, limitReached=false) outranks advisory percentages.
